tiers: 1. Surdus: 2/combat, glyphic action; A creature within 60 feet is deafened for 1 minute as twisted, black roots creep out of their ears.
2. Creatures deafened by Surdus have -1 physical resistance.
3. Creatures deafened by Surdus have -1 resistance against armour attacks.
4. Non-boss creatures deafened by Surdus deal -3 spell damage.
5. The next limited spell or maneuver you use after using Surdus deals +6 damage.

6. If you use Surdus on a creature already deafened by Surdus, a Medium, untargetable spire of twisted, black fibre grows from the ground in an unoccupied space adjacent to the creature for 1 minute. Foes within 60 feet of the spire are deafened by Surdus.
7. If you use Surdus on a creature already deafened by Surdus, the bonus numeric effects of Surdus from this glyph path are tripled for that target.
8. When you use Surdus, you may consume an additional use of it (if available) to force the target to make a save, becoming dominated until the end of its next turn on a fail.
9. Creatures deafened by Surdus have -4 physical resistance if you have used a limited spell or maneuver since the start of your last turn.
10. When you use Surdus on a bloodied target, it has -2 physical resistance while deafened by Surdus.
1. Pyramis: 1/SR, glyphic action; You tear a microscopic hole in reality, unleashing an eruption of energy in a 30 foot cone that deals 3 glyphic damage.
2. Pyramis' base damage becomes 6.
3. Pyramis can now be used once per combat, but after the first time it is used between short rests, it does 1 less damage.
4. Pyramis' base damage becomes 8 and its cone size increases to 60 feet.
5. Pyramis now only damages foes.
6. After using Pyramis, you immediately teleport to any space in the furthest row of its area.
7. After using Pyramis, its effect repeats in the same area at the start of your next turn. Additionally, its base damage becomes 9.
8. When you use Pyramis, you recover either 2 spell slot levels or 2 exertion. Additionally, its base damage becomes 10.
9. Whenever Pyramis repeats, roll a d4. On a 4, the repeat's damage is doubled.
10. Whenever Pyramis' repeat's damage is doubled, quadruple it instead.
1. Concursus: 1/combat, glyphic action; A prismatic spike of chaotic power erupts from your body towards a creature adjacent to you, dealing 6 glyphic damage to it.
2. Concursus' base damage becomes 12.
3. When you use Concursus, the target must make a save, becoming staggered for 1 round on a fail. Additionally, its base damage becomes 13.
4. When you use Concursus, the target takes 3 ongoing glyphic damage until it passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
5. Concursus deals +7 damage against targets with any resistances or immunities.
6. Creatures have a -1 penalty to any saves they make against Concursus' effects. Additionally, its base damage becomes 15.
7. Concursus splashes 2 damage and creatures have a -1 penalty to passive saves to end Concursus' ongoing damage.

8. When you use Concursus, the target must make a save, becoming slowed for 1 round on a fail. Additionally, creatures have a -1 penalty to saves against Concursus' stagger. Additionally, its base damage becomes 16.
9. Concursus can now be used twice per combat.
10. Concursus deals +3 damage for each condition or instance of ongoing damage inflicted by itself that the target is currently affected by.

1. Cohibere: 2/combat, glyphic action; A tentacle emerges from beneath your equipment, attempting to wrap around a creature adjacent to you. The creature must make a save, becoming restrained for 1 round, or until you move away from them, on a fail.
2. Whenever you restrain a creature with Cohibere, gain +2 reflex for 1 round.

3. Whenever you restrain a creature with Cohibere, the creature takes 2 ongoing glyphic damage until it passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses). Additionally, when the restrain ends, you gain +10' speed for 1 round.
4. You may use as many uses of Cohibere as you wish within the one glyphic action.
5. Creatures restrained by Cohibere have -2 resistance to armour attacks. This is increased to -4 if you've used a limited spell or maneuver since the start of your last turn.
6. Whenever Cohibere's restrain ends on a creature, that creature has -4 resistance to armour attacks for 1 round.

7. Whenever you are hit while restraining a creature with Cohibere, all Cohibere restrains immediately end and you erupt in glyphic power, dealing 9 glyphic damage to all foes adjacent to you for each restrain that ended.
8. Whenever you use Cohibere, its glyphic action is refunded. Additionally, whenever Cohibere's restrain ends, gain 5 temporary HP.
9. Upon using a limited spell or maneuver that targets a single adjacent creature, you may choose to immediately use Cohibere on that creature as a free action without expending any of its uses.
10. The explosion when you are hit while restraining a creature with Cohibere deals +2 damage and has +5' radius for each complete turn that the restrain was active for.

1. Fortificare: 1/combat, glyphic action; You manifest a floating suit of armour made from tiny castle walls and structures that orbits a creature within 60' of you for 1 round. This grants them +1 armour.
2. Creatures affected by Fortificare deal +3 damage.
3. Creatures affected by Fortificare deal +3 damage.
4. Whenever you use Fortificare, its glyphic action is refunded.
5. The damaging attacks of creatures affected by Fortificare deal +1d4 bludgeoning damage.
6. Whenever a creature affected by Fortificare hits with an attack, they inflict 3 ongoing glyphic damage until the target passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
7. The damaging attacks of creatures affected by Fortificare now scale with minion damage stats, in addition to their usual scaling. Additionally, those same creatures have +3 minion damage.
8. Creatures affected by Fortificare have +13 critical damage bonus.
9. While a creature has an active instance of ongoing damage caused by Fortificare, they deal +2 damage.
10. When a creature affected by Fortificare scores a critical hit, the Fortificare on them lasts until the end of combat.
1. Tolerare: 2/combat, glyphic action; You cause a creature within 60' of you to swell with muscle and flesh for 1 round, granting them +1 fortitude.
2. Creatures affected by Tolerare have +5 critical damage bonus and +5' Speed.
3. Whenever a creature affected by Tolerare hits with an attack, they inflict 2 ongoing glyphic damage until the target passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
4. Creatures affected by Tolerare deal +2 damage.
5. Creatures affected by Tolerare deal +2 damage.
6. Whenever you use Tolerare, its glyphic action is refunded.
7. If a creature's fortitude is its highest defence while affected by Tolerare, it gains +5 resistance against fortitude attacks.
8. Creatures affected by Tolerare have +5 resistance against fortitude attacks.
9. Creatures affected by Tolerare have +7 critical damage bonus and recover 7 HP whenever the score a critical hit.
10. Creatures affected by Tolerare deal +3 damage.
1. Velox: 2/combat, glyphic action; You conjure a small storm that whips around a creature within 60' of you, granting them +1 reflex for 1 round.
2. Creatures affected by Velox have +1 reflex.
3. Velox now also affects all allies adjacent to the target.
4. Whenever a creature affected by Velox is targeted by a reflex attack, Velox lasts on it until the end of combat.
5. Whenever Velox ends on a creature, they release a wave of water around them that deals 5 glyphic damage to all adjacent foes.
6. Whenever Velox ends on a creature, they release a 5'x5' twister centred on their space. The twister is a persistent zone that deals 3 glyphic damage to foes.
7. Creatures affected by Velox have +3 resistance against reflex attacks for each instance of Velox they have been affected by this combat.

8. For each round of the current combat that passes without you using Velox, your next use of Velox this combat will trigger that number of additional times, which still cost additional uses of the power.
9. While at least 2 creatures are affected by Velox, a bolt of lightning strikes a random foe adjacent to a creature affected by Velox at the start of each of your turns, dealing 9 glyphic damage.
10. Bolts of lightning can now be triggered by Velox while at least only 1 creature is affected by Velox.
1. Voluntas: 2/combat, glyphic action; You invoke a surge of awesome confidence in a creature within 60' of you, granting them +1 will for 1 round.
2. Voluntas now also affects all allies adjacent to the target.
3. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target are pushed 10' away from them.
4. Creatures affected by Voluntas have +2 resistance.
5. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target deal -2 damage for 1 round.
6. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target must make a save, becoming staggered for 1 round on a fail.
7. Whenever you use Voluntas, the target is healed for 2 HP, or 5 HP if they are bloodied.
8. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target take 3 ongoing glyphic damage until they pass a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
9. Creatures staggered by Voluntas have -2 resistance.
10. Whenever you use Voluntas, the next limited power the target uses deals +7 damage.
1. Motus: 1/SR, glyphic action; You move a willing creature within 60' of you with great speed. They immediately shift up to 10'.

2. When the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, that creature takes 4 ongoing glyphic damage until they pass a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
3. When the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, that creature takes 7 glyphic damage.
4. All damage dealt by Motus is increased by 2, and whenever Motus deals non-ongoing damage, the target of Motus heals 2 HP.
5. Whenever you use Motus on a creature, that creature gains +15' speed for 1 round.
6. The non-ongoing damage dealt by Motus is increased by 7 against targets taking ongoing damage.
7. If the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, the maximum shift distance increases by 15'.
8. Whenever you use Motus on a creature, that creature deals +8 damage with their next limited spell or maneuver.

9. When the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, leave a shadow of that creature in the space they left. This shadow acts like a CR 1/4 minion, but doesn't require your concentration and only scales with glyphic damage, no other stats.
10. The the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, the maximum shift distance increases by 15'.
1. Verto: 1/SR, glyphic action; You forcibly tear open the material plane, swapping spaces with a creature within 10' of you.
2. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, you may deal 6 glyphic damage to the other creature.
3. Verto's range becomes 20'.

4. At the start of your next turn after using Verto, you may choose to swap with the same creature again, so long as they are still within Verto's range. If the creature is dead, you may instead swap with any other creature within range.
5. At the start of your turn two rounds after using Verto, you may choose to swap with the same creature again, regardless of range.
6. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, you may inflict 3 ongoing glyphic damage to the other creature until they pass a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
7. Verto's cooldown becomes 1/combat and its base damage on swap becomes 7.
8. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, you may give the other creature -20' speed for 1 round.
9. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, the other creature becomes Sluggish for the remainder of combat.
10. Verto's range becomes 25' and all damage it deals is increased by 2.
1. Salvare: 1/combat, glyphic action; You surround a creature within 60' of you with a faint glow for 1 round, absorbing some of the negative energy around them. This grants the target +1 to saves.
2. Salvare now lasts for the remainder of combat.
3. Attacks that can inflict the frightened condition have -1 AB against creatures affected by Salvare. Additionally, those creatures have +1 resistance to will attacks.
4. Creatures affected by Salvare have +3 resistance to non-armour attacks.
5. From the second round of Salvare's effect and onwards, the target has +1 physical resistance and +1 resistance.
6. As a free action on your turn, you may immediately end Salvare's effect to cause negative energy to erupt from the target's body. All foes adjacent to the target take 15 glyphic damage.
7. Creatures affected by Salvare have +1 passive regeneration and +1 resistance to non-armour attacks.
8. If Salvare affects a creature for at least 2 rounds, it retains all resistance bonuses acquired from Salvare until it either takes a short rest or is affected by Salvare again.
9. The passive regeneration bonus granted by Salvare is increased to +3.
10. Creatures affected by Salvare cannot lose concentration against their will.
